mapping.description:
Extracts identity, provenance, security policy and execution metadata from Manifest V2 and Manifest V3 Chrome-based browser extensions.
- Identifies the extension, installed version directory and source manifest. - Captures declared API, host and optional permissions. - Records content-script targets, background code and externally accessible resources. - Preserves both Manifest V2 string and Manifest V3 object content-security policies.
